name: odin-test-explorer
description: Discover and run Odin unit tests in VS Code's Test Explorer.

odinTestExplorer.odinPath.description: Path to the Odin compiler executable.

odinTestExplorer.testArguments.description: Additional arguments passed to odin test before runtime test arguments.

odinTestExplorer.argumentProvider.description: Command that prints additional Odin test arguments as JSON. The workspace must be trusted.

command.description: Executable or script to run. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${packagePath}, ${userHome}, and ${env:NAME}.

cwd.description: Provider working directory. Relative paths resolve from the workspace folder. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${packagePath}, ${userHome}, and ${env:NAME}.

environment.description: Environment variables merged over the extension host environment for the provider. Values support ${workspaceFolder}, ${packagePath}, ${userHome}, ${pathSeparator}, and ${env:NAME}.

scope.description: Run once per package, or once per workspace folder per test run. Workspace scope cannot use ${packagePath}.

odinTestExplorer.testSuites.description: Source roots whose discovered packages are tested together in one Odin invocation.

name.description: Display name used in test output.

path.description: Suite source root. Relative paths resolve from the containing workspace folder.

arguments.description: Additional Odin compiler arguments for this suite, commonly including -all-packages.

odinTestExplorer.exclude.description: Glob pattern excluded from Odin test discovery.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
